name: depthwatch
description: Depthwatch: an open liquidity observatory for Base. Depth at ±1/2/5%, effective spread, LP concentration, liquidity persistence and a Liquidity Health Score for every Uniswap v3/v4 and Aerodrome pool on Base.

scripts.build:static: tsx apps/cli/src/main.ts export --demo --out apps/web/static-data/bundle.json && pnpm --filter @depthwatch/web build:static
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
